component.name: Apache StreamPark
component.description: Stream processing development management framework that allows users to submit Flink/Spark jobs to remote clusters, where they are executed unconditionally, without any attempt to limit what code can run.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Remote code execution through submitted Flink/Spark jobs
threats.description: StreamPark allows users to submit Flink/Spark jobs to remote clusters, which are executed unconditionally, without any attempt to limit what code can run. Remote code execution reports against this capability have historically been rejected: it is intentional design, not a security flaw.

controls.name: Restrict access to Flink/Spark cluster infrastructure
controls.description: Do not expose Flink/Spark processes to public internet access; corporate and cloud deployments should implement appropriate access restrictions to the Flink and Spark cluster infrastructure.
